title: add-rag-agent-templates-tool-calling-quickstarts-docs-update
author: Priya Sharma
release_notes: Adds RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and quickstart walkthroughs for Python and TypeScript; updates docs site navigation. No breaking changes.
description:
Context: This PR adds a set of opinionated RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, several tool-calling example playbooks, and step-by-step quickstarts for Python and TypeScript developers. Motivation: make it easier for engineers to onboard to Redwood's agent/tool-calling capabilities and to provide canonical templates for common patterns (QA, summarization, multi-tool orchestration).

What I changed (high level): added RAG agent templates under redwood-examples/rag-templates, new quickstarts in redwood-quickstarts/agents (python/ts), example tool adapters for calendar/search/db in redwood-examples/tool-adapters, and docs site updates (redwood-docs/content/agents/*) to include guides and code samples. Also updated the docs site sidebar and added a small migration note for customers using older agent APIs.

Checklist: - [x] Add templates and quickstarts - [x] Add TS and Python examples with runnable steps - [x] Docs site updates and sidebar entries - [x] CI docs build passes - [x] Reviewed by engineering and docs owners

Testing: Local smoke-tested both quickstarts (Python and TS) against the local dev server. Ran docs site build (hugo) in CI and verified new pages render correctly. Added basic unit tests for the new adapter helpers and ran existing test suite.

Notes for reviewers: The templates are intentionally opinionated (KV prefix caching + a single tool-router entrypoint) — open to suggestions on defaults. The quickstarts assume the reader has an API key and the rudimentary tooling (pip/npm). Migration note: older agent configs using `agent.run()` with positional tool args should switch to named tool maps; a short example is included in the docs page.

how_to_run_quickstart: Python: cd redwood-quickstarts/agents/python && python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && python run_quickstart.py --api-key $REDWOOD_API_KEY\nTypeScript: cd redwood-quickstarts/agents/typescript && npm install && npm run start -- --apiKey=$REDWOOD_API_KEY
examples_snippet: Python example snippet: agent = RagAgent.from_template('qa-agent', tools={'search': SearchAdapter()}); response = agent.ask('How many orders did we receive last month?')\nTypeScript example snippet: const agent = RagAgent.fromTemplate('summarize-agent', { search: new SearchAdapter() }); const resp = await agent.ask('Summarize the quarterly notes.');
